text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... I really did it. ☆ I managed to do it perfectly, and in front of this many people too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A feng shui dash that no one could
imitate!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so that's Copano Rickey, huh? She
uses
feng shui to help her run...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Watching her gives you goosebumps,
doesn't it?
It feels like she might pull off
something amazing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I never really noticed her before,
but she's
sparked my interest now.
Maybe I should check
out her next race.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer! ☆ With this, I've
managed to
connect the flow of
popularity from the Japanese
Derby to
the dirt track!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And there's one more thing to be
thankful for!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I'd never met you, Trainer, I probably
would
never have been able to enter the
Japanese
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, based on feng shui. This is
something I
haven't spoken about yet,
but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Quite a while back, I checked my
compatibility
with the Japanese Derby,
and it was pretty low.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Leading up to the race, I knew there was
a chance
something would happen to
keep me from
entering. Like being
blocked by fate or
something, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I felt a slight energy disturbance,
and that
seemed to have brought about
a change.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! ♪ It was you who brought it
within my
capacity to do something!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I don't really understand
everything
Copano Rickey is talking
about, but it seems
certain that I
contributed to her success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several days after the Japanese Derby...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, look Trainer! That store over there!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! The feng shui shop is packed with
people!
I've never seen it this crowded
before!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, check out these stones. Aren't they
so
pretty? Apparently, it's best to get
them in your
lucky color.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking about buying a book. I
wanna know
the best things to place
near my pillow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The shop is bustling with crowds of
customers.
There's even a large banner
outside.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: The banner says... let's see—Popularized by Copano Rickey! The Miraculous Power of Feng Shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Haha... I'm glad that it's becoming
popular, but
branding it as miraculous
seems a bit over the
top.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I prefer a more grounded
approach
showing people how practicing
feng shui leads to
improving one's own
luck.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The presentation may be hyperbolic, but
it's
better than having no one interested
at all.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This must be the result of my running in
the
Japanese Derby. I knew it would
garner a whole
different level of
attention! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I hope now even more people will start
getting
interested in feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several days after that...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer, check out this letter! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It says, "Trying out your feng shui has
made me a
little more positive-minded!
Now, I'm a huge
fan! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can really feel it—feng shui is
gradually
helping spread happiness to
everyone.
choice_data_list: Oh, that makes me so happy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep, this is perfect! As we enter the
ninth
solar term, summer welcomes us
with a bountiful
harvest! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I hope my feng shui spreads far and
wide! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being a hugely popular event, the
Japanese
Derby has helped capture the
interest of many
people. It looks like
Copano Rickey's strategy has
paid off.
